title: Frozen
subtitle: The Broadway Musical
description: Based on the blockbuster Disney film, Frozen brings the story of sisters Anna and Elsa to life on stage with an expanded score featuring new songs alongside the beloved originals. When Elsa's secret powers plunge Arendelle into an eternal winter, fearless Anna sets off on an epic journey to find her sister and save the kingdom. A visually stunning production with powerful vocal demands and rich character work.

roles.name: Elsa
roles.gender_notes: Traditionally female; some youth productions may explore flexible casting

casting_insights.typical_cast_description: Exceptional vocalist with a soaring belt and the ability to convey deep emotional isolation followed by powerful liberation. Must command the stage through stillness as much as power.
casting_insights.who_this_role_is_best_for: Powerful sopranos/mezzos with strong belt who can convey vulnerability beneath strength. Requires someone who can carry enormous vocal demands while staying emotionally grounded.
casting_insights.not_ideal_for: Performers whose primary strength is dance or comedy. This is a vocal and acting powerhouse role.

growth_profile.career_value: A-tier lead credit that demonstrates vocal excellence and dramatic depth

audition_guidance.what_directors_look_for: The voice first — can you sing 'Let It Go' and make people feel? Then the arc from fear to freedom. Elsa must be sympathetic even when pushing people away.
audition_guidance.common_mistakes: Over-playing the ice queen without showing vulnerability underneath. Trying to mimic Idina Menzel instead of finding your own Elsa.
audition_guidance.audition_tips: Choose a song that shows your belt AND your vulnerability. Start controlled, build to power. Show the emotional journey in 16 bars.

key_songs.title: Let It Go
key_songs.notes: The defining number — soaring belt, massive range, emotional liberation

key_songs.title: Dangerous to Dream
key_songs.notes: New stage song — shows Elsa's internal conflict and fear

key_songs.title: Monster
key_songs.notes: Act 2 power number — dark, intense, requires stamina

key_songs.title: I Can't Lose You
key_songs.notes: Duet with Anna — emotional resolution

roles.description: Elsa is the emotional core of Frozen — a young queen burdened by magical powers she cannot control. Her journey from terrified isolation to powerful self-acceptance is told primarily through extraordinary vocal performances. This role requires a voice that can fill a theatre and a heart that can break one.

roles.name: Anna

casting_insights.typical_cast_description: A charming, naturally funny actress with a strong mezzo belt who can carry the audience's emotional journey. Anna is on stage more than any other character — needs incredible stamina and likability.
casting_insights.who_this_role_is_best_for: Performers with natural warmth and comedic instinct combined with a solid belt voice. If you light up a room when you walk in, this could be your role.
casting_insights.not_ideal_for: Performers who are strongest in stillness or classical vocal style. Anna requires constant energy and physicality.

growth_profile.career_value: A-tier lead credit, demonstrates versatility — comedy + drama + vocals

audition_guidance.what_directors_look_for: Likability above everything. Can you make us laugh and then break our hearts? Natural physical comedy and genuine warmth.
audition_guidance.common_mistakes: Playing Anna as just bubbly without showing her determination and bravery. Also: trying too hard to be cute.
audition_guidance.audition_tips: Show your personality. Pick a song that lets your natural charm and humour shine through, with a belt moment to prove the voice is there.

key_songs.title: Do You Want to Build a Snowman?
key_songs.notes: Spans childhood to adulthood — shows emotional range

key_songs.title: Love Is an Open Door
key_songs.notes: Duet with Hans — comedic, charming, fast-paced

key_songs.title: What Do You Know About Love?
key_songs.notes: New stage song with Kristoff — shows growth

key_songs.title: True Love
key_songs.notes: Act 2 — emotional depth, realisation about sacrifice

roles.description: Anna is the heart of Frozen — endlessly optimistic, physically clumsy, and fiercely determined. She carries more stage time than Elsa and must sustain audience engagement through comedy, warmth, and genuine emotional moments. A triple-threat role that rewards natural charisma above all.

roles.name: Hans

casting_insights.typical_cast_description: A charismatic actor who can convincingly play the charming prince before the villain reveal. The twist must genuinely surprise the audience — requires subtle, intelligent acting.
casting_insights.who_this_role_is_best_for: Strong actors with natural charisma who can play layers. If you enjoy playing complex characters with hidden motives, this is your role.
casting_insights.not_ideal_for: Performers who struggle with subtlety or tend toward one-dimensional character work.

growth_profile.career_value: Strong supporting credit — demonstrates acting range and complexity

audition_guidance.what_directors_look_for: Can you be genuinely charming and then genuinely terrifying? The duality is everything.
audition_guidance.common_mistakes: Playing Hans as obviously evil from the start. The audience must believe the charm.
audition_guidance.audition_tips: Show your charm first. Pick a song where you're likable, then show a flash of something darker in the acting.

key_songs.title: Love Is an Open Door
key_songs.notes: Duet with Anna — must seem genuinely romantic

key_songs.title: Hans of the Southern Isles
key_songs.notes: Villain reveal — dark, controlled, satisfying

roles.description: Hans is one of the most interesting villain roles in modern musical theatre because for the first half, he isn't one. He's a charming prince who sweeps Anna off her feet, and the audience must believe it completely. The reveal requires an actor who can shift from warmth to coldness in a heartbeat.

roles.name: Kristoff

casting_insights.typical_cast_description: A likeable actor with good comic instinct and a solid baritone. Kristoff is the relatable everyman — grounded, funny, and genuinely good-hearted.
casting_insights.who_this_role_is_best_for: Baritones with natural comedic ability who can play the straight man. Less vocal demand than other leads — acting and likability are key.
casting_insights.not_ideal_for: Performers looking for a vocal showcase. Kristoff is more actor than singer.

growth_profile.career_value: Solid supporting credit in a major show — proves comedy + character work

audition_guidance.what_directors_look_for: Natural humour and likability. Chemistry with Anna is crucial — the pair need to spark.
audition_guidance.common_mistakes: Playing Kristoff as too grumpy without the warmth underneath.
audition_guidance.audition_tips: Be real and funny. Pick something that shows you can be gruff but lovable.

key_songs.title: Reindeer(s) Are Better Than People
key_songs.notes: Short, comedic, character-establishing

key_songs.title: What Do You Know About Love?
key_songs.notes: With Anna — chemistry and humour

key_songs.title: Kristoff Lullaby
key_songs.notes: Gentle, shows vulnerable side

roles.description: Kristoff is the grounded counterpoint to Frozen's magical world — a rough-around-the-edges ice harvester who reluctantly becomes Anna's guide. He's comedic without being a clown, tough without being mean, and loving without being sappy. A great role for actors with natural warmth and comic instinct.

roles.name: Olaf
roles.gender_notes: Traditionally performed by male actor; gender-flexible in many productions. Often played with a puppet.

casting_insights.typical_cast_description: A fearless physical comedian who can bring a puppet/character to life with infectious joy. Must steal every scene without overshadowing the leads. Often requires puppetry skills.
casting_insights.who_this_role_is_best_for: Born comedians with physical performance skills. If you can make people laugh without saying a word, this is yours.
casting_insights.not_ideal_for: Performers uncomfortable with physical comedy or puppetry. Also not for anyone who needs to be 'cool' on stage.

growth_profile.career_value: Scene-stealing supporting credit — proves unique performance skills

audition_guidance.what_directors_look_for: Fearless physical comedy and an infectious sense of joy. Can you make the audition panel genuinely laugh?
audition_guidance.common_mistakes: Playing Olaf as annoying rather than endearing. Too much noise, not enough heart.
audition_guidance.audition_tips: Be joyful, not try-hard. Bring physical comedy into your audition piece. If you can incorporate a prop or puppet work, do it.

key_songs.title: In Summer
key_songs.notes: THE Olaf number — comedic, physical, audience-connecting

key_songs.title: When I Am Older
key_songs.notes: New stage song — funny with a touch of heart

roles.description: Olaf is a magical snowman brought to life by Elsa's powers — innocent, joyful, and completely unaware of his own hilarity. On stage, this role often involves puppetry and demands exceptional physical comedy. Olaf gets some of the biggest laughs in the show and is remembered long after the curtain falls.

roles.name: Sven
roles.gender_notes: Non-speaking role performed in costume/puppet; gender irrelevant

casting_insights.typical_cast_description: A physically strong, expressive performer who can bring an animal character to life through movement alone. Must be comfortable in heavy costume/puppet rig with excellent stamina.
casting_insights.who_this_role_is_best_for: Physical performers, dancers, puppetry enthusiasts. If you express more through body than voice, this role showcases you.
casting_insights.not_ideal_for: Singers looking for vocal opportunities. This is a purely physical performance.

growth_profile.career_value: Unique credit that demonstrates physical performance skills beyond typical musical theatre

roles.description: Sven is Kristoff's loyal reindeer companion — performed entirely through physical theatre and puppetry with no singing. This is an incredibly demanding physical role requiring excellent stamina, expressiveness, and the ability to create a believable animal character. A unique and rewarding challenge for physical performers.

roles.name: Duke of Weselton
roles.gender_notes: Traditionally male; could be played by any gender in comedic productions

casting_insights.typical_cast_description: A character actor with strong comedic instinct who can make a pompous, ridiculous villain genuinely funny. Physical comedy is essential.
casting_insights.who_this_role_is_best_for: Character actors who enjoy being ridiculous. If you can get laughs playing pompous fools, this is perfect.
casting_insights.not_ideal_for: Performers seeking vocal showcase or serious dramatic work.

growth_profile.career_value: Fun supporting credit — demonstrates comedic range

roles.description: The Duke of Weselton is Frozen's comic villain — a pompous, tiny-man-with-big-ideas dignitary who provides consistent comic relief. His ridiculous dancing and outraged reactions are highlights. A gift for character actors.

roles.name: Pabbie (Grand Pabbie)

casting_insights.typical_cast_description: A performer with gravitas and a warm, deep voice. Small but impactful role.
casting_insights.who_this_role_is_best_for: Bass/baritones who command authority. Good for performers wanting a named credit without heavy time commitment.
casting_insights.not_ideal_for: Anyone seeking significant stage time or development.

growth_profile.career_value: Named supporting credit in a popular show

key_songs.title: Hidden Folk
key_songs.notes: Leads the trolls number

key_songs.title: Fixer Upper
key_songs.notes: Part of the trolls ensemble number

roles.description: Grand Pabbie is the wise leader of the Hidden Folk (trolls) who holds the key to understanding Elsa's powers. A small but important role with gravitas and warmth.

roles.name: Oaken
roles.gender_notes: Gender-flexible; traditionally played large and warm

casting_insights.typical_cast_description: A charismatic character actor with warmth and comedy. Oaken is a fan-favourite cameo role.
casting_insights.who_this_role_is_best_for: Naturally warm, funny performers. Great small role for someone who wants a memorable moment without heavy commitment.

growth_profile.career_value: Memorable cameo credit — always gets a laugh

key_songs.title: Hygge
key_songs.notes: New stage song — warm, quirky, audience favourite

roles.description: Oaken runs the Wandering Oaken's Trading Post and Sauna — a brief but beloved appearance. His warm 'Yoo-hoo!' and quirky charm make this one of the most memorable small roles in the show.

roles.name: Young Elsa

casting_insights.typical_cast_description: A mature young actress who can convey fear, love, and isolation beyond her years. Must transition believably into the adult Elsa's emotional world.
casting_insights.who_this_role_is_best_for: Young performers with exceptional emotional maturity and natural singing ability. A career-defining youth role.
casting_insights.not_ideal_for: Children who struggle with sustained emotional scenes or quiet, internal acting.

growth_profile.career_value: Top-tier youth credit — demonstrates maturity and ability to handle featured roles

key_songs.title: Do You Want to Build a Snowman?
key_songs.notes: Opens the song — must establish emotional foundation

key_songs.title: A Little Bit of You
key_songs.notes: With Young Anna — playful, sisterly

roles.description: Young Elsa opens the show and establishes the emotional foundation of the entire story. This is one of the most significant youth roles in modern musical theatre — the audience must fall in love with and feel sorry for this child in the first 10 minutes.

roles.name: Young Anna

casting_insights.typical_cast_description: An energetic, naturally charming young performer who radiates warmth and playfulness. Must make the audience love Anna instantly.
casting_insights.who_this_role_is_best_for: Bubbly, confident young performers with natural stage presence. Needs to be genuinely endearing.
casting_insights.not_ideal_for: Shy children or those who need significant direction to show personality.

growth_profile.career_value: Excellent youth credit in a beloved show

key_songs.title: Do You Want to Build a Snowman?
key_songs.notes: The heart-wrenching repeated question

key_songs.title: A Little Bit of You
key_songs.notes: With Young Elsa — sweet sisterly bond

roles.description: Young Anna is the sunshine to Young Elsa's shadow — a bubbly, hopeful child who doesn't understand why her sister won't play anymore. Her repeated knocking on Elsa's door is one of the most emotionally effective moments in the show.

roles.name: Ensemble — Townspeople of Arendelle

casting_insights.typical_cast_description: Strong ensemble singers who can harmonise, move well, and react convincingly to the magical events of the story.
casting_insights.who_this_role_is_best_for: Solid all-rounders building experience. Good entry point into large-cast Disney shows.
casting_insights.not_ideal_for: Performers seeking spotlight moments or heavy dance.

growth_profile.career_value: Ensemble credit in a popular Disney show — good foundation

key_songs.title: Vuelie / Let the Sun Shine On
key_songs.notes: Opening number — choral, atmospheric

key_songs.title: Coronation Day
key_songs.notes: Big celebration number — dancing + singing

key_songs.title: Finale
key_songs.notes: Full company finale

roles.description: The Townspeople of Arendelle form the world of the story — celebrating at the coronation, reacting in fear to the eternal winter, and ultimately joining in the resolution. A solid ensemble role with good singing requirements and moderate dance.

roles.name: Ensemble — Hidden Folk (Trolls)

casting_insights.typical_cast_description: Physical performers who can bring rock-like creatures to life with energy and comedy. Often requires puppetry or costume work.
casting_insights.who_this_role_is_best_for: Physical performers and dancers who enjoy character work. Great role for developing physical theatre skills.

growth_profile.career_value: Unique ensemble credit — demonstrates physical performance skills

key_songs.title: Hidden Folk
key_songs.notes: Introduces the trolls — physical + vocal

key_songs.title: Fixer Upper
key_songs.notes: The big troll number — comedic, high-energy, audience favourite

roles.description: The Hidden Folk (trolls) are magical, mischievous creatures who provide comic relief and mystical guidance. Their big number 'Fixer Upper' is a highlight of the show. This is a physical theatre role with puppetry/costume elements — great for performers who love character work and movement.

roles.name: Ensemble — Snow Chorus

casting_insights.typical_cast_description: Strong choral singers who can also move gracefully. They create the magical atmosphere of Elsa's powers on stage.
casting_insights.who_this_role_is_best_for: Vocally strong performers who enjoy creating atmosphere. Good for building choral and movement skills.
casting_insights.not_ideal_for: Performers seeking comedy, character work, or heavy spotlight.

key_songs.title: Let It Go (backing)
key_songs.notes: Vocal backing for Elsa's signature number

key_songs.title: Vuelie
key_songs.notes: Atmospheric choral opening

roles.description: The Snow Chorus creates the magical atmosphere of Frozen — the swirling snow, the choral backdrop to Elsa's powers, the ethereal quality of the world. Primarily a vocal ensemble with graceful movement, they are the visual and aural representation of Elsa's magic.
